meta.name: ulw-loop
meta.description: Goal-like loop that uses ultrawork mode to decompose work into systematic, evidence-bound steps.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把目标分解成有依据的执行步骤
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把复杂目标拆成可执行的步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Break down goals into evidence-bound steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn complex goals into actionable steps.

howto.what: 当你说出“ulw-loop”等指令时,Claude会先把目标按规则注册成清单,再把工作拆成细小的、可验证的步骤,一次只执行一个;每步完成都要用真实输出(终端、浏览器等)当作证据,涉及改代码会派子代理执行。
howto.when: 当你提到“ulw-loop”或“ulw”等关键词,或要求长期有检查点的交付时触发。

say.text: 用 ulw-loop 把‘发布网站’拆成步骤执行。
say.note: 它会先注册目标,再按清单逐步推进。

say.text: 启动 ulw-loop,目标是优化数据库查询,每一步给证据。
say.note: 每步完成会用真实输出验证。

howto.what_en: Invoking "ulw-loop" makes Claude register the goal, decompose work into small evidence-bound steps, and track them in a checklist (one in progress). Each step needs observable evidence (terminal, browser, etc.); code changes go to subagents.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention "ulw-loop" or "ulw", or ask for checkpointed long-running delivery.

say_en.text: Use ulw-loop to break 'launch the website' into steps.
say_en.note: It registers the goal and advances step by step.

say_en.text: Start ulw-loop with goal 'optimize DB queries', give evidence per step.
say_en.note: Each step is verified with real output.
